preconditions.description: The input is a single integer n representing the number of knights, where 1 ≤ n ≤ 10000.

postconditions.expression: stdout.strip() == '1/1' if n == 1 else stdout.strip() == '1/1' if n == 2 else stdout.strip() == '8/3' if n == 3 else stdout.strip() == '2/1' if n == 4 else all(c in '0123456789/' for c in stdout.strip()) and '/' in stdout.strip() and stdout.strip().count('/') == 1 and int(stdout.strip().split('/')[0]) > 0 and int(stdout.strip().split('/')[1]) > 0 and math.gcd(int(stdout.strip().split('/')[0]), int(stdout.strip().split('/')[1])) == 1
postconditions.description: The output is an irreducible fraction 'a/b' representing the expected number of coin tosses needed to select one knight uniformly at random from n knights, where the fraction is in its simplest form (gcd(a, b) = 1).
